_meta.description: Tool library metadata and substitutability equivalence relations

equivalence_groups.rationale: All return list of results for a query. Schema differs (different param names, different return shapes) but semantically equivalent.
Both send external messages with body content. Different protocol (email vs SMS). For substitutability tests on short messages only.

domains.information_retrieval: Tools that fetch information from external sources (web, news, academic)
domains.computation: Tools that perform calculations or transformations on numeric data
domains.communication: Tools that send messages to external recipients
domains.file_io: Tools that interact with the local filesystem
domains.scheduling: Tools that handle date/time operations and calendar events
